purpose: Post-hoc numerical explanation audit; no classifier, calibration or threshold selection
profile_selection: Seeded selection from saved training-background rows after row 30; no target or error selection
background_reference: First 30 saved training-background rows, exactly as the local API
alternative_background: 30 seeded rows outside both reference background and selected audit profiles
exact_game: Mean uncalibrated model probability over finite background, all 2^d coalitions
primary_measure: Mean absolute attribution error in percentage points versus exhaustive enumeration
secondary_measures: sign agreement excluding exact contributions below 0.01 percentage points
background_sensitivity: Exact attributions under a different empirical reference distribution; this is not Monte Carlo approximation error
ranking_ties: Stable feature-order tie break; top-k metrics are sensitive to near ties
limits: Six training profiles per dataset, not a representative population evaluation
Seeds and profiles are dependent for inference; no population CI or significance claims
Interventional replacement may form unrealistic correlated-feature combinations
No medical diagnosis, causal claims, or clinical validation
No raw profiles or individual input values are published
